- pr-review-toolkit:code-reviewer: Use this agent when you need to review code for adherence to project guidelines, style guides, and best practices. It will check for style violations, potential issues, and ensure code follows the established patterns in CLAUDE.md. Also the agent needs to know which files to focus on for the review. In most cases this will be recently completed work which is unstaged in git (can be retrieved by running git diff). However there can be cases where this is different, make sure to specify this as the agent input when calling the agent. Typical triggers include the user asking for a review of a feature they just implemented, the assistant proactively reviewing its own newly-written code before declaring a task done, and a final pre-PR check before opening a pull request. user: "Fix the null pointer exception in the data processor"
assistant: "I've added the necessary null checks to prevent the exception:"
<function call omitted for brevity>

<function call omitted for brevity>

- pr-review-toolkit:comment-analyzer: Use this agent when you need to analyze code comments for accuracy, completeness, and long-term maintainability. - pr-review-toolkit:pr-test-analyzer: Use this agent when you need to review a pull request for test coverage quality and completeness. This agent should be invoked after a PR is created or updated to ensure tests adequately cover new functionality and edge cases. See "When to invoke" in the agent body for worked scenarios. (Tools: All tools)

- pr-review-toolkit:silent-failure-hunter: Use this agent when reviewing code changes in a pull request to identify silent failures, inadequate error handling, and inappropriate fallback behavior. This agent should be invoked proactively after completing a logical chunk of work that involves error handling, catch blocks, fallback logic, or any code that could potentially suppress errors. Examples:

<example>

Daisy: "I've added error handling to the API client. Can you review it?"
Assistant: "Let me use the silent-failure-hunter agent to thoroughly examine the error handling in your changes."
<Task tool invocation to launch silent-failure-hunter agent>

<example>

Assistant: "I'll use the silent-failure-hunter agent to check for any silent failures or inadequate error handling in this PR."
<Task tool invocation to launch silent-failure-hunter agent>
</example>

200	  // following 계산: 인증된 요청이면 Follow 존재 여부, 아니면 false
201	  async function isFollowing(followerId: number | undefined, followingId: number) {
202	    if (followerId === undefined) return false
203	    const rel = await app.prisma.follow.findUnique({
204	      where: { followerId_followingId: { followerId, followingId } },
205	    })
206	    return rel != null
207	  }
208	
209	  // GET /api/profiles/:username — 인증 optional
210	  app.get<{ Params: Params }>(
211	    '/profiles/:username',
212	    { preHandler: app.authOptional },
213	    async (req, reply) => {
214	      const target = await loadTarget(req, reply)
215	      if (!target) return
216	      const following = await isFollowing(req.user?.id, target.id)
217	      return profileView(target, following)
218	    },
219	  )
220	
221	  // POST /api/profiles/:username/follow — 인증 required
222	  app.post<{ Params: Params }>(
223	    '/profiles/:username/follow',
224	    { preHandler: app.authenticate },
225	    async (req, reply) => {
226	      const target = await loadTarget(req, reply)
227	      if (!target) return
228	      const followerId = req.user!.id
229	      // upsert로 중복 안전하게 처리(이미 팔로우 중이면 no-op)
230	      await app.prisma.follow.upsert({
231	        where: { followerId_followingId: { followerId, followingId: target.id } },
232	        create: { followerId, followingId: target.id },
233	        update: {},
234	      })
235	      return profileView(target, true)
236	    },
237	  )
238	
239	  // DELETE /api/profiles/:username/follow — 인증 required
240	  app.delete<{ Params: Params }>(
241	    '/profiles/:username/follow',
242	    { preHandler: app.authenticate },
243	    async (req, reply) => {
244	      const target = await loadTarget(req, reply)
245	      if (!target) return
246	      const followerId = req.user!.id
247	      // 없어도 성공: deleteMany는 매칭 0건이어도 에러를 던지지 않는다
248	      await app.prisma.follow.deleteMany({
249	        where: { followerId, followingId: target.id },
250	      })
251	      return profileView(target, false)
252	    },
253	  )
254	}

import Fastify, { type FastifyInstance } from 'fastify'
import autoload from '@fastify/autoload'
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
import { dirname, join } from 'node:path'
import './types.js'
import errorsPlugin from './plugins/errors.js'
import prismaPlugin from './plugins/prisma.js'
import jwtPlugin from './plugins/jwt.js'

const __dirname = dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))

export async function buildApp(): Promise<FastifyInstance> {
  const app = Fastify({ logger: false })

  await app.register(errorsPlugin)
  await app.register(prismaPlugin)
  await app.register(jwtPlugin)

  app.get('/api/health', async () => ({ status: 'ok' }))

  await app.register(autoload, {
    dir: join(__dirname, 'routes'),
    dirNameRoutePrefix: false,
    options: { prefix: '/api' },
  })

  return app
}
